name: psi0.4
summary: The RGBC foundation checkpoint that begins the PSI training lineage.
recipe: 500k steps of RGBC pre-training.

name: psi0.5
summary: The first RGBCFD PSI checkpoint, adding flow and depth to the original visual recipe.
recipe: 500k steps of RGBC pre-training.
200k steps of RGBCFD pre-training.

name: psi0.5-base
summary: The released psi0.5 checkpoint with an additional 32k-context extension phase.
recipe: 500k steps of RGBC pre-training.
200k steps of RGBCFD pre-training.
50k steps of RGBCFD context extension at 32k context, batch size 64, with a dropped learning rate.

name: psi0.5-ctx128k
summary: A long-context extension of psi0.5-base for sequences containing up to 100 video frames.
recipe: Train for another 5k steps on RGBCFD sequences with up to 100 video frames, using 128k context length and batch size 64.

name: psi0.5-r
summary: The robotics-specialized psi0.5 checkpoint, combining robot pre-training with context extension.
recipe: 500k steps of RGBC pre-training.
200k steps of RGBCFD pre-training.
80k steps of robotics-data pre-training.
20k steps of robot-data context extension at 32k context and batch size 64.

name: psi0.5-r-libero
summary: A LIBERO-specialized post-trained robotics checkpoint built from psi0.5-r.
recipe: Run 10k steps of LIBERO post-training with RGBCFD, batch size 64, and sequence length 4,096.

name: psi0.5-r-abc
summary: The planned ABC-specialized branch of the psi0.5 robotics checkpoint.
recipe: Run 45k steps of ABC post-training with RGBCFD.
Finish with 5k steps of ABC context extension at 32k context.

name: psi0.6
summary: A multimodal continual-pre-training checkpoint that adds text to the RGBCFD recipe.
recipe: Continually pre-train for 500k steps with RGBCFDT data.

name: psi0.6-vlm
summary: A VLM-focused psi0.6 branch trained with learning-rate dropping and context extension.
recipe: Train for 30k steps on VLM datasets with learning-rate dropping.
Run the final 20k steps at 32k context length and batch size 64.

name: psi0.6-r
summary: The planned robot-text specialization of psi0.6.
recipe: Train for 200k steps on robot-text data with RGBCFD.

name: psi0.6-r-abc
summary: A planned ABC post-training branch of psi0.6 using the expanded text-conditioned modality set.
recipe: Run 45k steps of ABC post-training with RGBCFDT.
Finish with 5k steps of ABC context extension using RGBCFDT at 32k context.

name: psi0.7
summary: The point-track PSI checkpoint, extending psi0.6 with point supervision.
recipe: Pre-train for 200k steps on point tracks and RGBCFDT data, using the full RGBCFDTP modality set.

name: psi0.7-poking
summary: A dropped, high-resolution continuation of psi0.7 for point-track poking data.
recipe: Continue to 1.5M steps at high visual resolution with dropping on point tracks and RGBCFDT data.

name: psi0.7-r
summary: The planned robotics continuation of psi0.7, preserving point tracks throughout robot training.
recipe: Follow the 200k-step psi0.6-r robotics recipe on robot data with the full RGBCFDTP modality set.
